payload.content_text: The people team and the executive leadership need to align on a working arrangement that allows the company to attract the best talent regardless of location, keeps teams genuinely collaborative and productive, protects the culture that makes the organisation successful, and treats all employees fairly regardless of where they choose to work.

issues: attract the best talent regardless of location
keeps teams genuinely collaborative and productive
protects the culture that makes the organisation successful
treats all employees fairly regardless of where they choose to work

working arrangement: hybrid with 2-3 days in office per week
flexible arrangements decided by individual teams
attract the best talent regardless of lo: provide relocation packages for in-office roles
keeps teams genuinely collaborative and: use of collaboration tools like Slack and Zoom
set clear productivity metrics and goals
protects the culture that makes the orga: create a shared digital space for cultural engagement
treats all employees fairly regardless o: adjust salaries based on cost of living
offer equal access to promotions and benefits
provide stipends for remote work expenses
